attempts.text:
**The window starts on a spine.** Column 0, `yddG`, an aromatic amino acid efflux DMT transporter, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names it in 98% of calls, with 0.24 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns**, columns 1 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 90% of calls. The model names 63 to 98% there, mean 87%, and hesitates most at column 12, `ydcD`, named 63%, 1.99 bits, in a region of plasticity in 90% of calls. The forks carry second branches: `fdnI` to `gadB` through columns 3 to 20, `yddB` to `ydeS` through columns 22 to 32, `lsrR` to `uxaB` through columns 38 to 47, `yneG` to `ptrR` through columns 49 to 52, `ydeA` to `marB` through columns 54 to 58, `ynbE` to `uspF` through columns 65 to 72, `dcp` to `rspR` through columns 73 to 75, and `ydaN` to `smrA` through columns 76 to 78.

**The forks themselves are mostly persistent.** `narU` is carried by 84% of chromosomes, `narZ` by 81%, `narH` by 85%, `narW` by 85%, `narI` by 85%, with `fdnG` and `fdnH` at 15% and 14%. The `nar` genes work in [[nitrate reduction]]. Later forks run `mnaT` to `hicB`, then `yncJ`, then `rimL` to `cybB`, then `aldA` to `ynbC`, then the `paa` operon, [[phenylacetic acid degradation]], from `paaY` to `paaZ`, carried by 35 to 53% of chromosomes.

**Hesitation is highest where plasticity is highest.** The 28 columns where most calls are in a region of plasticity are named in 81% of calls at 0.84 bits; the other 52 columns are named in 90% at 0.48 bits. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.18 against 0.33 bits, and names fewer genes, 74% against 93%. The window ends at column 79, `ydbL`, in 41% of chromosomes.

label: yddG
facts:
WINDOW: the yddG window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yddG, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,250 to 2,329 from dnaA. Read in 531 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yddG once); 42,480 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 87% of genes, 0.61 bits on average (perplexity 1.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 24,035 calls, named 95%, 0.25 bits; shell 17,831 calls, named 78%, 0.97 bits; cloud 614 calls, named 9%, 4.40 bits. Outside an RGP 28,403 calls, named 93%, 0.33 bits; inside an RGP 14,077 calls, named 74%, 1.18 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 71 fork, 8 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.18 against 0.33 bits) and names fewer genes (74% against 93%); 14,077 of the 42,480 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 12 (ydcD) 1.99 bits, RGP 90%; column 11 ("hypothetical protein") 1.78 bits, RGP 85%; column 13 (rhsD) 1.58 bits, RGP 89%. The 28 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 81%, 0.84 bits on average; the other 52 columns: named 90%, 0.48 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 1-90%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yddG "aromatic amino acid efflux DMT tran…". named 98%; 0.24 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-90%. named 63-98% (mean 87%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 12, named 63%, 1.99 bits.
